mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.sku_id, d.batch_number, d.prod_date, d.expire_date, d.count, d.received_count, d.supplier_id, d.price, d.warehousing_entry_id, d.real_arrival_time, d.predicted_arrival_time, d.unload_emp_id, d.unload_time, d.status, d.qc_status, d.qc_pass_count, d.qc_fail_count, d.create_time, d.create_by, d.update_time, d.update_by, s.code AS sku_code, p.title AS spu_title, IFNULL(s.is_sn_managed, 0) AS is_sn_managed, IFNULL(s.qc_type, 2) AS default_qc_type, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(u.count), 0) FROM wms_warehousing_entry_up u WHERE u.entry_details_id = d.id AND u.status = 2 AND u.is_del = 1) AS putaway_count FROM wms_warehousing_entry_details d LEFT JOIN wms_item_sku s ON s.id = d.sku_id LEFT JOIN wms_item_spu p ON p.id = s.spu_id WHERE d.warehousing_entry_id = #{entryId} AND d.is_del = 1 ORDER BY d.id
